notes: 4.348 extension (ords 2/3/9, ENGINE unit): view-level reclaim for grouped-view chains — @Hint('reclaim_group_aged/freq') on a groupwin now sweeps per-group child state (drop groups with inactivity strictly greater than the aged bound; sweep piggybacks on incoming events at most once per frequency window, armed on the first update; Engine.AdvanceTime alone never triggers it; removed groups detach silently with no old-stream rows, matching Java's removeSubview detach). New introspection APIs: Statement.ScheduleCount and Engine.ScheduleCountOverall synthesize the pending callback count from window/pattern/output state (one callback per time-driven window state with live future-deadline work — mirroring Java TimeWindowView's handle-while-non-empty lifecycle). reclaim-aged-hint trims the suite's 10x1000 sends to 10x100 for replay tractability; both engines replay the same trimmed scenario and pin identical iterator counts (600/601). reclaim-time-window pins the 10→1→0 schedule-count progression; reclaim-flip-time pins 1→2→2 across the aged boundary at 4999/5000.
